scientific_integrity: The classification follows analytically from the source's generator moment correspondence plus an explicit two-atom moment construction. The three-point parents are written in closed form and independently regression-checked by direct discrete order-statistic computation. Finite checks supplement, rather than replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to exactly four strictly increasing expected order statistics from iid integrable observations. It classifies identification versus nonidentification but does not enumerate every parent distribution in the nonidentified interior. An equivalent specialization may exist in older order-statistics or truncated-moment literature not retrieved by the searches.
title: Exact identifiability boundary for four expected order statistics
